name: Aeon Phocus
full_name: Aeon Phocus electromagnetic catheter steering system
versions: single system: CE mark announced 2015-07-30 (startupticker2015_aeon); host of the ETH magnetic-catheter tests of 2017 (chautems2017_tethered, chautems2017_variable); company no longer in business (li2020_magnetic Sec. 3.4); 'discontinued despite regulatory approval' (mandhumula2025_robotic)
target_anatomy: cardiac arrhythmias (catheter ablation) in all four heart chambers (chautems2017_tethered Sec. III-A)
devices_driven: magnetic ablation catheters (model N.R.); in ETH tests a tethered magnet (NdFeB, 29 mm long, 5 mm radius) and variable-stiffness magnetic catheters with LMPA segments (chautems2017_tethered Fig. 7; chautems2017_variable)
n_dof_detail: 3 (alekseeva2025_design Table 14); field and field gradient from 7 electromagnets (chautems2017_tethered Sec. II)
translation_detail: magnetic (field gradient on the tip magnet); catheter advance mechanism N.R.
rotation_detail: tip direction by field of 7 electromagnets arranged around the patient's torso (li2020_magnetic Sec. 3.4); static electromagnets (chautems2017_tethered Sec. I) vs 'movable electromagnets' (mandhumula2025_robotic): conflict
footprint_mm: N.R. (encloses the patient's upper body, li2020_magnetic Fig. 6b)
force_sensing: none in the system; ETH added Hall sensors around the workspace for field correction (chautems2017_tethered Sec. II)
haptics_leader: no: joystick in a separate control room (li2020_magnetic Sec. 3.4; chautems2017_tethered Sec. III-A)
imaging_compat: integrated with a Siemens Artis Zee angiography system (chautems2017_tethered Fig. 6; li2020_magnetic Sec. 3.4)
validation_detail: bench only in the sources read: tethered-magnet trajectories and force measurements inside the Aeon Phocus at Aeon's lab (chautems2017_tethered Sec. III); variable-stiffness catheter configurations in the Aeon field (chautems2017_variable Fig. 3). Clinical use is stated ('a medically certified system currently in clinical use', chautems2017_tethered abstract) but no patient study was found; alekseeva2025_design Table 14 gives 'ex vivo phantom studies (TRL3)'
key_numbers: 7 electromagnets; model vs measured force error below 0.01 N, nine points at 0.071 +/- 0.005 N (chautems2017_tethered Sec. III-C); field controlled closed-loop at 1 Hz in the ETH tests (chautems2017_tethered Sec. II); 100 mT used to load a VS catheter with 0.003 Nm (chautems2017_variable Sec. III)
sim_model: none found (linear field model with saturation correction, no simulator; chautems2017_tethered Sec. II)
